blocks.label: Acquisition
blocks.instructions:
Vessel IdentificationLearn to identify the two vessels.
  • Feedback is not always reliable — the sonar environment adds noise
  • Try to learn which vessel is which despite occasional misleading feedback

blocks.label: Reversal
blocks.instructions:
Continue — Rules May ChangeContinue identifying vessels.
  • Feedback remains noisy — about 20% of feedback is unreliable
  • The correct identification may also change during this block
  • Track patterns across multiple trials, not just the last one
